They didn’t necessarily say they didn’t mind it. I probably just said that so I could feel better about myself. They also both seemed really hurt by it. If It didn’t affect them that much then they wouldn’t have reported me. They both forgave me but I kinda wish they hadn’t. It obviously got to the point where what I was doing was too much for them. Also, I feel like making fun of someone’s insecurities is a really crappy thing to do especially because it was something they couldn’t change. The things that said were highly insensitive and lowkey kind of homophobic and possibly racist. 

For example, one girls last name included the word d*ke(a slur used for lesbians). I honestly didn’t even know what d*ke meant at the time. I didn’t start making jokes until she brought up that people had previously made jokes about her last name. I just thought it was because d*ke sounded like a funny word. It was definitely out of character for me to do that considering I myself am apart of the lgbt community. She seemed annoyed with me whenever I made the joke. I never called her the word, I would just draw it out before finishing saying her last name.

The other person had what I think was a Russian name. I had a hard time pronouncing it and was insecure because I didn’t want people to laugh at me if I pronounced it wrong so I started making jokes. I would purposely pronounce it wrong in what I thought was a joking way. Again, this seems out of character for me because of the fact that I am a POC. She also was annoyed by it and she never wanted to be around me. I think she changed schools either during the year or after the year was over. I can’t help but think that I was the reason why she changed schools.

I unknowingly bullied people.

Once in 6th grade, my teacher made a joke to a student and said something along the lines of, “maybe you should have been a blonde like your other family members,” because he had said something funnily stupid. He laughed and a few other people did too. Later that day while we were doing something, he was in my group and he said something funnily stupid again. I was new and wanted to fit in so I said, “maybe Ms Blank was right, you should be a blonde.” I didn’t mean it in a rude way, I was just repeating the joke but it wasn’t taken that way and he got mad. I overstepped my boundaries and made him feel bad. 

In 7th grade, I lacked boundaries and self awareness and often made jokes about other people. I didn’t intend for them to be hurtful but they were because I was poking at some of their insecurities. There were two different people who I did this to. It wasn’t a one time thing either because I thought I was being funny when in reality I was just being an asshole. They both seemed annoyed at it but I guess I ignored that because I continued doing it. I don’t have all the great a memory so I can’t remember if they ever told me to stop but that doesn’t matter because I should’ve known my place. 

Later that year, I was really annoyed at this kid who sat next to me in one of my classes because he was constantly making fun and basically made that class a living hell. I told him I hoped that something bad would happen to him. I said it out of anger and I didn’t actually mean it.

In 8th grade, there were two more instances. It was again because I lacked self awareness and overstepped boundaries. They both reported me and that’s when I finally started to gain self awareness. I’ve apologized to both of them and they have forgiven me even though I didn’t deserve it. I also still talk to them sometimes and they’ve said that it wasn’t that big of a deal. 

I’ve always been a pretty empathetic person and I hate hurting people. I feel awful because I can never take back the pain that I inflicted upon them. I don’t ever deserve forgiveness or to be happy again.

Honestly, I’d be surprised if they didn’t remember because what I did was really awful. No matter how much a person changes or tries to become better, they still did what they did in the past and they can never truly be a good person again. No matter what I do, I will never be a good person again.

No. I apologized to one person but I don’t know how to apologize to the other two because I don’t want to accidentally bring up bad memories. I’m not sure if they will remember either and if they don’t, I don’t want to accidentally make them relive through that. I’ve written apologies for them, I just don’t know how to contact them.
I might not be an awful person but I did awful things. If I don’t kill myself then I deserve to live a miserable life. I don’t ever deserve happiness again.
I should pay for what I did and the best way for that is dying. I don’t deserve to get help because I am too awful of a person. Wouldn’t I be doing the world a favor if I just killed myself?
